_comment: A second shipped policy, and the clearest demonstration that a use case is
data: it scopes to entirely different object classes and asks entirely
different questions from appearance.json, with no code difference at all.
Also the practical one for street footage that contains vehicles but no
people — with appearance.json bound, such a clip detects buses and cars
correctly and examines nothing, because no demand matches.

attributes.justification: Dominant colour of the vehicle body is directly visible
Which face of the vehicle is toward the camera is directly visible
Illuminated lamps on the vehicle are directly visible
attributes.question: Report only lamps you can see lit. Do not infer whether the vehicle is braking or turning.
